<page>
 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2023-CV-0042
 Joshua Lee, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
11-10-23
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to
Rule 92, Defendant further asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or contributed to the collision. Plaintiff changed lanes without first ascertaining
that such movement could be made safely, failed to keep a proper lookout, and failed to yeild the right-of-way to
vehicles lawfully occupying the lane, and such conduct proximately caused the sideswipe. Under Chapter 33 of the
Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility,
and Plaintiff may be barred from recovery if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, Defendant invokes the proportionate responsibility provisions of Chapter 33, and requests that the trier of
fact determine the percentage of responsibility of each claimant, defendant, settling person, and responisble third
party designated under Section 33.004.
Third, Plaintiff's alleged damages were not proximately caused by the collision. Certain injuries, conditions, or
treatment claimed by Plaintiff pre-existed the occurrence, arose from unrelated causes, or resulted from a
subsequent event, and Defendant denies liability for any such damages. Defendant further asserts its right to a credit
or offset for any settlement amounts paid to Plaintiff by any other party for the same damages.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
